content.text: But the other thing is size. Because you're putting two meals together, usually brunch is
content.trans: 但是另一个问题是尺寸。因为您正在把两个大餐一起做，通常来说是早餐。

content.text: very big. You eat a lot of food.

content.text: Okay, so it's a perfect combination of breakfast and lunch.

content.text: I'm the type of person that likes having scrambled eggs at noon.

content.text: So this is a perfect solution. brunch.

content.text: Right, you don't have to only eat eggs at breakfast. You can eat them at lunch as well.

content.text: Very good. And talking about eggs and the types of eggs that we can have.
content.trans: 很好。说说我们能吃哪些类型的鸡蛋吧。

content.text: I mentioned scrambled eggs. And in the dialogue, we also heard soft boiled eggs.
content.trans: 我提到了散装鸡蛋。在对话中，我们也听到了软煮鸡蛋。

content.text: Okay, these are two very important kinds of eggs. Usually if you're in a restaurant,
content.trans: 好的，这些都是非常重要的两种鸡蛋。通常在餐馆里吃的话，有这两种鸡蛋的餐点会很受欢迎哦！

content.text: they will ask you how do you want your eggs cooked or done.
content.trans: 他们会让你决定你想要的鸡蛋是煮熟了还是煎好。

content.text: And my answer is always scrambled.
content.trans: 我的答案总是乱七八糟的。

content.text: Scramble.
content.trans: 乱码。

content.text: This means someone mixes the eggs before they are cooked.
content.trans: 这意味着鸡蛋是生的就被混在一起了。

content.text: And then when they cook, they are hard. They're yellow.
content.trans: 然后他们做饭的时候，很硬。他们是黄色的。

content.text: Okay.
content.trans: 好的。

content.text: There's no white. It's just yellow. And it's a little hard mixture.
content.trans: 没有白色。只是黄色，有点混合不均匀。

content.text: But soft boiled eggs are very, very different.
content.trans: 但溏心蛋真是非常非常不同。

content.text: That's right. Soft boiled eggs. You actually don't break the egg or open the egg to cook it like in scrambled eggs.
content.trans: 没错。软-boiled鸡蛋。你实际上不破壳或打开蛋来煮，就像炒鸡蛋那样煮。

content.text: You actually put the entire egg in boiling water.
content.trans: 你真的把整个鸡蛋放进沸水中了。

content.text: I think it's for two minutes. And then you take it out. And then you open the shell.
content.trans: 我觉得是两分钟。然后你拿出来。然后你打开壳。

content.text: And the eggs are kind of cooked. It's kind of hard in some parts.
content.trans: 鸡蛋有点煮熟了。有些地方有点硬。

content.text: But it's also kind of liquidy in other parts.
content.trans: 但其他地方也挺稀汁的。

content.text: That's right. So the outside, the white part is hard.
content.trans: 没错。外面的白色部分很硬。

content.text: But the yellow part, the yolk, is liquid. It's not hard.
content.trans: 但黄色部分，蛋黄是液态的。它不硬。

content.text: That's right. And actually if you want the whole egg to be hard,
content.trans: 没错。而且，如果你想整个鸡蛋都变硬，就真的需要一点耐心和时间呢。

content.text: you can ask for hard boiled eggs.
content.trans: 你可以要硬-boiled鸡蛋。

content.text: That's right. Those are cooked for much longer.
content.trans: 没错。这些都是煮得很久的。

content.text: That's right. Okay.
content.trans: 没错。好的。

content.text: So we have scrambled eggs, soft boiled eggs. We have French toast.
content.trans: 所以有煎蛋、软煮鸡蛋。我们有法式吐司。

content.text: And we have buttermilk pancakes.
content.trans: 当然，我们有煎蛋卷。

content.text: Okay. So you can ask for just pancakes.
content.trans: 好的。你可以只点煎饼。

content.text: But if you want to be specific, you want to give instructions about what kind of pancakes you can ask for buttermilk pancakes.
content.trans: 但如果你想要具体一些，你想要提供关于可以要求的面糊类型的信息，比如要的是牛奶煎饼。

content.text: And what exactly is buttermilk?
content.trans: 那到底是什么是奶昔？

content.text: Buttermilk is a very, very creamy, eggy milk that's very, very high in fat.
content.trans: 但是，黄油是一种非常非常浓稠、带有蛋味的牛奶，它的脂肪含量非常高。

content.text: That makes everything taste better. I think this is used a lot in baking.
content.trans: 那这样就会让一切的味道更好。我觉得这在烘焙中用得挺多的。

content.text: Not really in other kinds of foods. So you can have buttermilk muffins or buttermilk biscuits.
content.trans: 当然不是在其他类型的食品里。你可以吃但是不要吃的饼干或松饼。

content.text: But usually you have buttermilk pancakes. And so these are very rich, very fatty pancakes.
content.trans: 但通常你会有酸奶油煎饼。所以这些是非常丰富的，非常油腻的煎饼。

content.text: Awesome. Yeah. They taste delicious.
content.trans: 太棒了。没错，它们真的很好吃。

content.text: Alright. So now if we want to eat a little bit more healthy, we do have some cereal and some musely.
content.trans: 好的。所以现在如果我们想吃点稍微健康一点的食物，我们有一些麦片和一些肉松。

content.text: Musely is a funny word. It's not a sound we make very often in English musely.
content.trans: 肌肉是这个单词。虽然它不常在英语中出现，但它听起来很有趣。

content.text: Yeah. I think it actually comes from German.
content.trans: 是的。我觉得其实来自德语。

content.text: It does look German. Because actually the spelling is MUE.
content.trans: 确实看起来像是德语。因为实际上拼写是 MUE。

content.text: So you would kind of want to say MUE-Ezly, mu-Ezly or something.
content.trans: 所以你可能会想说MUE-Ezly、mu-Ezly什么的。

content.text: Yeah. Now we say musely. And it's basically a mixture of granola or different kinds of fiber grains.
content.trans: 嗯。现在我们就说肌肉样。这基本上是谷物棒或者是不同种类的纤维种子的混合物。

content.text: Yeah. So just think of having raisins and maybe some almonds, granola, all mixed up.
content.trans: 好的。那么就想想有葡萄干和可能还有一些杏仁、燕麦片，全都混在一起。

content.text: And you have this nice thing that goes well with yogurt musely.
content.trans: 而且你这个东西和酸奶很搭。

content.text: It's very, very tasty and also very good for you.
content.trans: 确实很好吃，也很适合你。

content.text: Okay. And now, well actually going back to pancakes, no pancake is possible to eat unless you put syrup on it, right?
content.trans: 好的。现在，确实回到煎饼了。没有糖浆，你不可能吃上煎饼的哦。

content.text: Well some people might disagree. I know a lot of people who eat pancakes with honey or butter.
content.trans: 有些人可能会有不同的看法。我知道有很多人喜欢用蜂蜜或黄油吃煎饼的。

content.text: On true. But the best I think is with syrup. And syrup is basically liquid sugar.
content.trans: 确实。但我觉得最好还是蜂蜜。而蜂蜜就是液态糖。

content.text: And you put it on your pancakes to make them sweeter.
content.trans: 你把它放在煎饼里，让它们变得更甜。

content.text: Okay. Actually it's the same thing as honey basically except that it doesn't come from bees.
content.trans: 好的。其实和蜂蜜是一样的，只不过它不是从蜜蜂那里来的。

content.text: Right. So real syrup, we say maple syrup comes from maple trees and you tap the tree and it comes out.
content.trans: 好的。所以真正的糖浆，我们说枫糖来自枫树，你去打洞，然后它就出来了。

content.text: It's very, very, very sweet. But we also have syrup you can buy at the store which is...
content.trans: 这真是太甜了。但是我们还可以在店里买到可以买的糖浆呢……

content.text: Artificial.

content.text: ...manmade. Yeah, it's basically just sugar.
content.trans: 确实人工制造的。对了，基本上只是糖而已。

content.text: Okay. Very good. So that's what we have with pancakes usually.

content.text: When the guy was kind of surprised, he said, wow, you really went all out.

content.text: Okay, so this comes from the phrase to go all out. So he went all out or I'm going to go all out.
content.trans: 好的，所以这是“全力以赴”的意思。所以他全力以赴了，还是我去全力以赴？

content.text: And this means to give something your best, to do more than is expected.

content.text: Right. So if you go all out when you're making breakfast, it means you just, you cooked a lot or really good and you spend a lot of time doing it.

content.text: Or for example, if it's someone's birthday and I know it's their birthday, I go all out by buying gifts and a cake and lots of decorations and calling all of their friends and having a party.
content.trans: 英语：或者，例如，如果某人的生日是今天，我尽我所能地为他们买礼物、蛋糕和装饰品，并邀请他们的朋友们参加派对。

content.text: So this is doing everything for them.

content.text: That's right. Okay. And he was really surprised and he really seemed to enjoy breakfast.

content.text: Okay, this is a way to say good job or nicely done.

content.text: It's almost a way to say, I'm happy about this.

content.text: It looks good. So it's a way to say, you know, well done, looks good or in this case looks very tasty.

content.text: That's right. Okay.

content.text: So let's take a look at this verb, squeeze.
content.trans: 所以，让我们来看看这个动词“挤”。

content.text: To squeeze. This is something you usually do with your hand when you tighten something.
content.trans: 为了挤。这是你通常用你的手来做的，当你紧固某物时。

content.text: So for example, your toothpaste.
content.trans: 例如，你的牙膏。

content.text: Yes, you squeeze your toothpaste so the toothpaste will come out.
content.trans: 是的，你挤牙膏是因为要让牙膏出来。

content.text: So in this case, we are squeezing the orange juice to extract the juice.
content.trans: 在这种情况下，我们是把橙汁挤出来提取果汁。

content.text: That's right. So you hold the orange very tight. You make the juice come out.

content.text: And then you have fresh squeezed orange juice.
content.trans: 然后你就有新鲜榨的橙汁。

content.text: And this is different from orange juice you buy in a store.

content.text: Okay. So you can say, I'll squeeze us some fresh orange juice.

content.trans: 好的。那么说到早午餐，你们的常规或理想早餐是什么呢？

content.text: Oh, that's a hard question. Breakfast is my favorite meal of the day.
content.trans: 哦，那真是个难回答的问题。早餐是我一天中最喜欢的餐点。

content.text: So I could eat breakfast, all kinds of breakfast anytime.
content.trans: 所以，我就可以随时吃早餐了。

content.text: But one of my favorite kinds of breakfast is a Greek diner breakfast.
content.trans: 但我的最爱早餐之一是希腊快餐厅的早餐。

content.text: Greek diner. What does this have?
content.trans: 希腊餐厅。这是什么？

content.text: Okay. Well, we have a lot of diners or small restaurants that are very, very cheap and fast in America.
content.trans: 好的。我们有很多美国的餐馆或小饭店，非常便宜而且快速。

content.text: And this usually involves some scrambled eggs that are made with cheese and toast and potatoes and bacon and sausage and a coffee.
content.trans: 这通常包括一些用芝士、面包、土豆和培根做成的 scrambled 鸡蛋。

content.text: Wow. Big breakfast. Very big.
content.trans: 哇。一大早就吃早餐。真大。

content.text: But delicious. Nice. What's your favorite?
content.trans: 但很好吃。不错。你的最爱是什么呢？

content.text: I also really, really like breakfast and I actually like having places that you can have 24 hour a day breakfast.
content.trans: 我也真的很喜欢早餐，而且我确实喜欢那些可以提供全天候早餐的地方。

content.text: All day breakfast is called. So I can have breakfast for dinner.
content.trans: 全天早饭叫啥？这样可以晚上吃早餐。

content.text: Right. That's usually in America you go to a diner because they have breakfast at four o'clock in the morning or at seven o'clock at night.
content.trans: 好的。那通常在美国，你去一家比萨店是因为他们早上四点或晚上七点有早餐。

content.text: I'm not really a coffee person. I actually enjoy either juice, orange juice or hot chocolate.
content.trans: 我不是真的咖啡爱好者。我其实更喜欢果汁、橙汁，或者是热巧克力。

content.text: I really like hot chocolate. And definitely pancakes. Three buttermilk pancakes stacked.
content.trans: 我真的很喜欢热巧克力。当然也喜欢煎饼果子。三个打成一团的牛奶煎饼。

content.text: And as you said before, syrup, but I actually also put butter on it.
content.trans: 你之前说的对，糖浆嘛，但是我其实也加了黄油进去。

content.text: Gross. I know a lot of people who do that. They put butter on first.
content.trans: 我知道很多喜欢这样做的朋友。他们先放上黄油。

content.text: Yeah. And then they pour the syrup. Yeah, of course. So it's like complete, very, very fatty and hash browns.
content.trans: 好的。然后他们浇入糖浆。当然了。这就像是超级肥腻的煎饼卷。

content.text: I'm definitely fat in the hash browns. Those are potatoes that are chopped very, very finely and you fry them together.
content.trans: 我肯定是在煎薯条的时候胖了。那些是切得超级细的马铃薯，一起煎着吃。

content.text: So it almost becomes like a potato pancake.
content.trans: 所以它几乎变成了一块土豆饼。

content.text: Yeah, exactly. So a lot of great stuff. And obviously breakfasts around the world are different.
content.trans: 是的，完全正确。所以有很多很棒的东西。当然了，世界各地的早餐都不同。

content.text: I know for example, in some countries they have the fisherman's breakfast. So in the morning you have black coffee, rice and fish.
content.trans: 我知道，比如在一些国家，他们有渔民的早餐。所以早上你有黑咖啡、米饭和鱼。

content.text: That's right. Because you're going to work all day. So we're really curious about how breakfast is in your country.
content.trans: 没错。因为你今天要工作一整天，所以真的很想知道你国家的早饭是怎么样的。

content.text: What a typical breakfast is like. Yeah, what are traditional breakfasts? And what is your favorite breakfast?
content.trans: 你典型的早餐是什么样的？对了，传统的早餐是什么呢？你的最爱是哪一种呢？

content.text: Let us know on our website, EnglishPod.com. We hope to see you there. All right. Bye. Bye.
content.trans: 好的，我们可以在我们的网站上联系到你。希望你能光临。好的。再见。再见。
